headline: Elgrove Mother Nature Menace
title: Elgrove | Mother Nature Menace Grass Attack Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Elgrove turns you into a Grass fighter. Its partner skill, Mother Nature's Menace, changes your attack type to Grass and raises your Attack by thirty to fifty percent. At base it is a flexible worker, with Planting, Lumbering and Transporting all at level three. Mining and Gathering come at level two. Is Elgrove your Grass pick? Comment below!
description: Elgrove in Palworld 1.0: Mother Nature's Menace switches your attack to Grass with a 30 to 50 percent boost, and it works Planting, Lumbering and Transporting at level three.
